skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit that the mercenary, W, wears most often.
Since that moment, this outfit has become W's favorite.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
After receiving Rhodes Island's permission, a certain dangerous person received a lot of dangerous weapons.
She happily tinkered with these weapons to make the best use of them whenever needed. Even working with these ruined industrial products never left a trace on her clothing — or rather, she prepared a lot of embellishments to maintain her disguise with ease.

skins.name: Fugue
skins.content: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Fugue. Ordinary Sarkaz mercenary wear. Easy to mend, protective, and carries even more explosives after simple modification.
skins.quote: After hearing of Theresa's past deeds, for just a moment, W was truly lost thinking about it: 'Are there really people who'd go and put childlike ideals like that into practice?'
